title: Matrix Balance Deviation Analysis
description:
Consider an m x n binary matrix 'grid'. For every row 'i' and column 'j', we define:
- onesRow[i]: The count of 1s in row i.
- zerosRow[i]: The count of 0s in row i.
- onesCol[j]: The count of 1s in column j.
- zerosCol[j]: The count of 0s in column j.

Your task is to construct a difference matrix 'diff' of the same dimensions, where each element at (i, j) is calculated as:
diff[i][j] = onesRow[i] + onesCol[j] - zerosRow[i] - zerosCol[j]
input_format:
The first line contains two integers m and n, representing the number of rows and columns.
The next m lines each contain n space-separated integers, representing the elements of the binary matrix.
output_format: Print the m x n difference matrix. Each row should be on a new line, and elements within a row should be space-separated.
constraints:
1 <= m, n <= 100000
1 <= m * n <= 100000
grid[i][j] is either 0 or 1
